api.notes: Spacing step; a number attribute (gap="4"). A value off the scale is ignored with a dev warning.
Number is px, string a CSS length; not reflected. Sizes the host.
Sizes the host, so a percentage resolves against the stack's parent.
Renamed: browsers give an `align` attribute presentational meaning (A§7.2, CONVENTIONS §9).
Enumerated (div, section, article, aside, nav, header, footer, main, ul, ol, li); renders the real element inside the shadow root.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style on the host (sizes, flex, margin), ::part(base), or the padding/gap attributes.
The element itself is the handle; the flex box is reachable as part "base".

hooks.reason: StyleX utility that adds flex-container styles to any element. tct-stack is the element form; a plain element uses the same display:flex declarations.

differences.text: `align` is the `alignment` attribute (and property): browsers treat an `align` attribute on some elements as `text-align` (A§7.2).

`as` is enumerated (div, section, article, aside, nav, header, footer, main, ul, ol, li) instead of any ElementType. `form` is left out because a <form> in a shadow root does not own slotted controls.

The host carries the sizes (width, height, max-width, min-height) and an inner part="base" box carries flex, gap and padding, so a percentage size resolves against the stack's parent and padding survives an application reset. Custom properties inherit through slots, so the host resets the private box values for nested stacks.

A stack rendered as ul or ol gets role="list" on the inner element so list semantics survive list-style:none in Safari; aria-* on the host is mirrored onto a non-div inner element so a landmark can be named.

A scrolling stack, stack item or fixed-height card that really overflows and holds nothing tabbable becomes a tab stop (`tabindex="0"` on the inner box, shared focus ring), so it can be scrolled with the keyboard in Safari as well as in the engines that make scrollers focusable themselves (Chromium 130+, Firefox). Upstream leaves this to the browser. The stop is removed when the content fits or brings its own tab stop; it follows content and slot changes through the shared resize observer. [mwg:accessibility]

requests.reason: Optional hardening: BoxPropsMixin removes a custom property when its attribute goes away, but custom properties inherit through the flat tree, so a nested box reads its parent's padding/size unless its own sheet resets them. The layout folders reset `--_box-*` to `initial` on :host (and write the values on the host, see STACK-03). Writing `initial` instead of removing the property would make the reset part of the mixin.

core.stack.notes: Guides: [mwg:css-layout] flexbox, gap, logical properties, flex items; [mwg:styling-web-components] host rules, part=base, custom-property inheritance; [mwg:shadow-dom] slots inside the flex container; [mwg:accessible-web-components] landmark and list semantics in the shadow root, aria delegation; [mwg:custom-elements] reflection of enumerated attributes. Size budget 14 kB (above the S default of 12): Stack bundles BoxPropsMixin, the static-tag switch for as="ul|ol|nav|…" and StackItem on top of lit (13.7 kB gzip measured).

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style on the host (it is the flex item), or ::part(base).
The element itself is the handle.

hooks.reason: StyleX utility that adds flex-item styles to any element. tct-stack-item is the element form; a plain element uses flex, min-width and min-height declarations.

differences.text: The host is the flex item: size and cross-align-self are reflected attributes read by :host rules, so consumer styles on <tct-stack-item> (margin, width, flex) reach the flex item directly.
as="li" renders a real <li> in the shadow root, which the browser exposes as a list item; axe wants native <li> children of a list, so the docs recommend them.

core.stack-item.notes: Guides: [mwg:css-layout] flex item min-size reset, flex shorthand; [mwg:styling-web-components] host rules. Size budget 14 kB (above the S default of 12): Stack bundles BoxPropsMixin, the static-tag switch for as="ul|ol|nav|…" and StackItem on top of lit (13.7 kB gzip measured).
